tagline: Electric violet, volt and ink pages with every edge cut on one twelve-degree angle: italic condensed capitals, skewed streaks and a volt band.

palette.description: electric violet page, volt highlight, near-black third tone, coral for one chip per page at most

typography.style: always-italic uppercase condensed display at weight 900 with a medium Barlow body

best_for: Launches and campaigns that should feel fast. Each slide takes one tone (violet, volt or ink) and one oversized word or number.
avoid_for: Quiet or text-heavy material; the display is capitals only and tolerates very few words.
name: Aero Kinetic
